meta.name: git-master
meta.description: Handles git work: atomic commits, rebase, squash, blame, bisect, reflog, and history questions. Use whenever a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation; skip for ordinary code edits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理零散代码改动，变成逻辑清晰的提交记录，并追查每处修改的由来。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你每天都在提交代码，想让每次提交都有条理，也想知道某一改动是怎样来的。
copy.tagline_en: Keep a clean commit history and trace the story behind any code change.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Git daily and want clean commits and full insight into your change history.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会接管 git 操作:提交、rebase、squash,以及查历史(谁在何时改了哪一行)。它会先读仓库状态再动手,你没明确要求就不会推送、重置、删东西。
howto.when: 当任务需要提交代码或调查 git 历史时接管;普通的代码编辑不适用。

say.text: 把当前改动拆成几个原子提交
say.note: 先看完整 diff,按行为分组提交

say.text: 这个文件第 20 行是谁改的?
say.note: 用 blame 和 log 给出提交哈希

say.text: 把这次修改 fixup 进上一个提交

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude handles git work: commits, rebase, squash, and history questions such as who changed a line and when. It reads repo state first and won't push, reset, or delete anything unless you explicitly ask.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation; skipped for ordinary code edits.

say_en.text: Split my current changes into a few atomic commits
say_en.note: Reads the full diff, groups by behavior

say_en.text: Who last changed line 20 of this file?
say_en.note: Uses blame and log to cite the commit hash

say_en.text: Fixup this change into the previous commit
